import inspect
from collections.abc import Callable

    is_coroutine = inspect.iscoroutinefunction(func)
    while callable(wrapped := getattr(func, "__wrapped__", None)):
        func = wrapped
        is_coroutine = is_coroutine or inspect.iscoroutinefunction(func)
    return is_coroutine
